text:
acme-admin: Hey team, sudden spike in SSO failures for Acme users since last night. ~40% 403s on login.
acme-admin: Error in browser: "SAML RecipientValidationFailed: ACS mismatch" and relaystate sometimes redirects twice.
acme-admin: We rotated the IdP signing cert 48h ago, but metadata endpoint is up: https://idp.acme.com/saml/metadata
emma: sorry to hear that — looking. Any chance you rotated the EntityID or changed ACS host?
acme-admin: No entityID change. We only pushed a new cert/key pair, plus a small nginx proxy change to trim trailing slashes.
liam: pulling our auth logs now. I see a lot of requests hitting ACS; the assertion Recipient = https://app.acme-prod.com/saml/acs but our expected ACS is https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs (we canonicalize host).
raj: @liam can you paste the last 8 lines of the SAML debug? Also, any X-Forwarded-* differences from the CDN/proxy?
liam: sure — paste: ```[2026-03-15T22:07:12Z] SAML: InboundAssertion Recipient=https://app.acme-prod.com/saml/acs
[2026-03-15T22:07:12Z] SAML: ExpectedRecipient=https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs
[2026-03-15T22:07:12Z] SAML: RelayState=/dashboard -> Redirect /sso/finish (302)
[2026-03-15T22:07:12Z] SAML: Redirect loop detected (RelayState seen twice)
[2026-03-15T22:07:12Z] SAML: Validation failed: RecipientValidationFailed
```
emma: interesting — the incoming Recipient is the customer's ACS (app.acme-prod.com) not our canonical host. That suggests the IdP is still posting to the original ACS URL they had configured. Did we recently change public host for hosted accounts?
acme-admin: we changed nothing on app.acme-prod.com. Our proxy strips trailing slash on /saml/acs and we enabled host header rewrite to internal origin last week.
raj: that host rewrite could cause the redirect/relaystate behavior. If the proxy rewrites Host to internal name, the assertion Recipient may not match what our service expects. Also double-posts often come from an intermediate redirect (302) from CDN when metadata URL changed.
liam: I fetched the IdP metadata: ```curl -s https://idp.acme.com/saml/metadata | xmllint --format - | sed -n '1,120p'``` The metadata contains two <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> entries — one with oldKeyId and one with newKeyId. Both present. The Signature on the metadata references key oldKeyId.
acme-admin: we thought publishing both keys would be fine to allow rollover.
emma: rollover pattern is fine but if IdP is sending assertions signed by the new key while metadata still points to oldKeyId in the Signature, some SPs validate the metadata differently. Could be timing/race between metadata and cert propagation to our cache.
liam: our metadata poller last fetched at 2026-03-15T20:00:00Z; the customer updated metadata at 2026-03-15T21:45:00Z. We will force-refresh, but the incoming assertions are already failing.
raj: quick triage steps: 1) confirm IdP assertion signature key thumbprint (ask customer to paste saml response debug), 2) force metadata cache refresh on our side, 3) check proxy X-Forwarded-Host behavior and disable host-rewrite temporarily, 4) invalidate CDN cache for /saml/* endpoints.
acme-admin: sending a sample HTTP POST with base64 SAML (sanitized) via DM.
liam: got it. The assertion's SignatureKeyInfo KeyName = newKeyId and the thumbprint matches new cert. So IdP is signing with new key but some proxies/our cache still expect old.
emma: pushing a metadata refresh now and enabling a metric to surface RecipientValidation failures. deploy-bot: triggered metadata-refresh job for acme-account (run id 7812).
deploy-bot: metadata-refresh started, hit https://idp.acme.com/saml/metadata, fetched new document, updated cache-v2, cleared local key cache.
liam: retested login -> initial 302 still happening but now Assertion Recipient matches expected host (we see https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs in logs). However browser still gets redirect loop when RelayState contains trailing slash.
raj: that fits the proxy rewrite: if RelayState -> /dashboard/ vs /dashboard mismatch we can accidentally redirect and set RelayState again. acme-admin can you revert the trailing-slash strip on the proxy for /saml/acs and /sso/*?
acme-admin: done — reverted that change and restarted the proxy. Pushed config rollback at 2026-03-15T23:50Z.
liam: reattempting SSO -> success for 12 test users, failures dropped to ~1%. RelayState loops gone.
emma: leaving watch on errors for next 4 hours and notifying account team. acme-admin: recommend keeping both keys in metadata for 72 hours during rollover and ensure metadata signature references the new key (or that the cached signature validation path accepts). Also avoid rewriting Host header for SAML post endpoints.
acme-admin: thanks everyone — we'll adjust our rollout plan and keep you posted. :pray:
raj: adding a short KB note for support: "If customers see RecipientValidationFailed after IdP cert rollover: force metadata-refresh, confirm signature key id in assertion, check proxy host/relaystate rewrites, and invalidate CDN caches."
emma: will file a follow-up ticket to surface this class of failure as an alert (SAML RecipientValidation spikes).
